instruction: Read the user's exact script aloud once, as a brisk, natural male tech host speaking General American English. Use a clearly masculine, medium-to-low speaking register, like talking to a friend, with a light, curious energy. Keep a steady pace around 220 words per minute.
opening_instruction: Read I'm Goo and the show name as one connected thought, then flow straight into {transition}.
reading_instruction: Use very short pauses and natural question intonation. Pronounce Goo with a hard G, rhyming with too. Pronounce Lemme like lem-ee. Speak only the script.
